senses.gloss:
उच्चैस्, ind. (used adjectively in comp.) aloft, high,
above, upwards, from above; loud, accentuated; in-
tensely, much, powerfully.
—उच्चैः-कर, अस्, आ, अम्,
making acutely accented.
—उच्चैः-कुल, अम्, n. a
high family; (अस्, आ, अम्), of high family.
—उच्चैर्-
घुष्ट, अम्, n. making a loud noise, clamour.
—उच्चैर्-घोष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sounding aloud,
crying, neighing, roaring, rattling.
—उच्चैर्-भुज-
तरु, उस्, उस्, उ, having trees like outstretched arms.
—उच्चैः-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, carrying one's head high,
a man of high rank.
—उच्चैः-श्रवस्, आस्, m. long-
eared or neighing aloud; epithet of the horse of
Indra, produced at the churning of the ocean, (re-
garded as the prototype and king of horses.)
—उच्चैः-
श्रवस, अस्, m. = the same.
—उच्चैः-स्वर, अस्, m.
a loud sound or voice; (अस्, आ, अम्), making a loud
sound.
—उच्चैस्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, very high, tall or
lofty; very loud.
—उच्चैस्-तमाम्, ind. exceedingly
high; on high; loudly, aloud.
—उच्चैस्-तर, अस्, आ,
अम्, higher, very high, loftier, louder; pronounced
with a higher accent.
—उच्चैस्तर-त्व, अम्, n. state
of being too high.
—उच्चैस्-त्व, अम्, n. height.
—उच्चैः-स्थान, अम्, n. a high place; (अस्, आ, अम्),
of high rank or family.
—उच्चैः-स्थेय, अम्, n.
lofty, firmness (of character).
